versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00028 In case of multiple faults during a call of Rte_Send the resulting return value shall be derived according to the following priority rules (highest priority first): 1. RTE_E_SEG_FAULT 2. RTE_E_LIMIT (only in case of Intra-ECU communication) 3. RTE_E_HARD_TRANSFORMER_ERROR 4. RTE_E_COM_STOPPED 5. RTE_E_SOFT_TRANSFORMER_ERROR
